meta.title: Bebilog — Baby Tracking, Simplified
meta.description: Track feeding, sleep, growth, vaccines, and more — all in one beautifully designed app.

hero.subtitle: Track feeding, sleep, growth, vaccines, and more — all in one beautifully designed app. Insights that help you care with confidence.

smartLog.label: Smart Log
smartLog.title: Just say it.
smartLog.description: Powered by Apple Intelligence. Speak, type, or snap a photo of a daycare note — Smart Log parses it into multiple records instantly. No forms, no tapping. All processed on-device.

tracking.label: All-in-One Tracking
tracking.title: Everything your baby needs,
tracking.description: 12 record types designed by parents, for parents. Log feeds, sleep, diapers, growth, and more in seconds — not minutes.

insights.label: Insights
insights.title: See the
insights.description: Real-time Sleep Window and Feed Window tell you when your baby is ready — no guessing. Plus six-dimension growth analysis, trend spotting, and professional reports for your pediatrician.

predictions.label: Smart Predictions
predictions.title: Know when,
predictions.description: Bebilog learns your baby's rhythm and predicts the next feed and sleep window. No more guessing — just timely notifications when it's time.

growth.label: Growth Charts
growth.title: Medical-grade
growth.description: WHO standard growth charts with z-score references. Born early? INTERGROWTH-21st preterm charts activate automatically with corrected age display.

vaccine.label: Vaccine Schedule
vaccine.title: Never miss
vaccine.description: Smart scheduling for China (NIP), US (CDC), Japan, and Europe. Tracks doses, minimum intervals, and live-vaccine rules automatically.

food.label: Baby Food Hub
food.title: Introduce food
food.description: AI-powered 7-day meal plans by age stage. Track allergen introduction with clear status indicators and safety cooldown windows.

grid.title: What else can Bebilog do?
grid.subtitle: And so much more — all included.

privacy.title: Your baby's data stays
privacy.subtitle: No accounts. No servers. No tracking. Just you and your baby's data.

local.title: 100% Local Storage
local.description: All data lives on your device. No sign-up, no cloud dependency. Works offline, always.

icloud.title: iCloud Sync
icloud.description: Optionally sync across your Apple devices via iCloud. End-to-end encrypted by Apple — we never see your data.

noTracking.title: Zero Tracking
noTracking.description: No analytics, no ads, no third-party SDKs. We don't collect, sell, or share any personal information.

onDevice.title: On-Device AI
onDevice.description: Smart Log uses Apple Intelligence processed entirely on your device. Your baby's data never leaves your phone.

pricing.title: Simple, honest pricing.
pricing.subtitle: Start free. Upgrade when you're ready.

footerCTA.title: Start tracking today.
footerCTA.subtitle: Free to use. No account needed.

midCTA.title: Still deciding?
midCTA.subtitle: Free to use, no account needed — try it today.
